create.name: Melbourne Zen Group
create.bio:
The Melbourne Zen Group is a lay Zen community in Brunswick East, in Melbourne's inner north, and part of the Diamond Sangha lineage, which draws on both Rinzai and Sōtō Zen. A handful of people who had sat retreats with Robert Aitken Rōshi started it in 1985. Its visiting teachers are Subhana Barzaghi Rōshi, who took on the role in 1999, and Susan Murphy Rōshi, who joined her in 2002; both are based in New South Wales and come to Melbourne twice a year for retreats and workshops. Since 2024 a long-standing member, Kirk Fisher, authorised as a Rōshi by Susan Murphy, has been the resident teacher. Practice includes both just sitting (shikantaza) and koan work.

The group rents a dojo in the Learning Centre at CERES, a community environment park beside Merri Creek, and meets there on Tuesday evenings and Saturday mornings, with a laptop link for people joining from home and short online sittings on weekday mornings. Newcomers book a free orientation first. Kirk Fisher gives private interviews at the dojo a few times a month and by phone, and the calendar adds half-day zazenkai and a residential sesshin with the visiting teachers. The group is volunteer-run, has around seventy members and keeps a collection of recorded talks.

courses.title: Orientation and weekly group meditation
courses.description: A free orientation of just under an hour, covering Zen basics, dojo forms and sitting posture, held before the regular sittings on the first Saturday and third Tuesday of each month; newcomers then stay on for group meditation. Bookings are by email.

courses.title: Residential sesshin with Subhana Barzaghi Roshi and Aladdin Jones Sensei
courses.description: A week-long residential retreat in the Strathbogie Ranges in country Victoria on the theme of the Sandokai, combining silent zazen with daily qigong led by Peter Wong. Booking is through the group's calendar page.

courses.title: Dokusan with Kirk Fisher Roshi
courses.description: Private interviews about one's practice with the group's local teacher, offered during sittings at CERES a few times a month and monthly by phone. Non-members may attend a few times; regular dokusan is for members, and teachers are supported by dana.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Members share in decisions about the group, have ongoing access to dokusan, get booking priority for some events and can borrow from the library of books and recorded talks. Newcomers are encouraged to sit with the group for a few months first.
courses.price: $120 to $180 full; $60 to $90 concession (annual, sliding scale)

free_resources.title: MZG teisho collection
free_resources.description: Recorded talks by the group's teachers, among them Subhana Barzaghi, Susan Murphy, Kirk Fisher and Robert Aitken, free to stream or download, some transferred from old cassette tapes.

free_resources.title: Online weekday sittings
free_resources.description: Short Zoom sittings early on weekday mornings, plus an online link into the Tuesday and Saturday dojo sittings, open after an orientation.
